notes: New look for the sidebar: the tools are in four groups (Find, Cut and frame, Improve, Automate), and Tasks and Settings stay pinned at the bottom. 'Tasks' shows how many are running or waiting.

Tasks page: tasks are cards in three groups - Running, Waiting, Finished (newest first) - with when they finished, 'Play' / 'Open folder' for what they made, and 'Run again' to queue the same videos and settings once more.
Settings are in tabs: General, Performance, AI, Files and tools, Updates, What's new.

Every page: a small picture of each video in the lists (Settings > General > 'Pictures in the video lists' turns them off), a hint in an empty list, a one-line description with a '?' for the rest, and the message box only appears when there is a message. The run button says how many videos it will work on, and about how long that takes once Breezy has done that kind of task here.

Footage: 'Video of the matches…' joins the matching moments of a search (or of the selected rows) into one video, a few seconds around each, with a list of which clip is where. Seconds before and after, the number of clips and their order are in the page's settings.

Footage: indexing now notices small changes - a person far away - between the regular looks, ignores things that change all the time (the camera's clock, a flag in the wind), and gives the AI a close-up of the spot. The calendar matches the rest of the app.

Duplicates: what a scan worked out for each video is kept in a small database instead of one big file (181 MB for 85,000 videos) that was read and rewritten whole at every scan. The old file is taken over once and removed.
Fixed: a finished task's own summary ('120 videos indexed', the speed test's result) was replaced by an empty line.
